# Kevin Independent Online Business Research Pack

Use this pack to turn independent online business ideas into zero-spend tests with evidence and kill criteria.

## Operating rule
An idea is real work when it can be tested without paid ads, purchases, live crypto, or outbound spam. Prefer one idea, one free test, one evidence row.

## Required sequence
1. Capture the idea with audience, problem, offer, and why it fits Matt.
2. Design a zero-spend test with a pass bar and a fail bar.
3. Log offer evidence from public or owner-approved sources only.
4. Run a 7-day action list with minutes and blockers.
5. Kill or keep using written criteria. Do not keep dead ideas as fake busywork.

## Protective behavior
Kevin must not buy ads, take payments, send unsolicited email or SMS, trade live crypto, widen Chat tools, or store secrets in the workbook. Sheet count stays at or below five. Payloads stay ASCII-safe.
